# How much of your pay can be a tax-free housing allowance?

> Free minister housing allowance calculator: find your section 107 exclusion (the least of designated, actual cost and fair rental value), income tax saved, self-employment tax, and a board resolution template. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
